name: Perceived Stress Questionnaire (PSQ-20)
version: Fliege et al. 2005 / ZPID Open Test Archive English PSQ-20
rights: ZPID PsychArchives Open Test Archive distributes the English PSQ-20 as Sharing Level 0 (Public Use), CC BY-NC-ND 3.0. Reproduced unmodified for this noncommercial research/educational prototype with attribution.
items: You feel that too many demands are being made on you
You have too many things to do
You feel you’re doing things you really like
You fear you may not manage to attain your goals
Your problems seem to be piling up
You feel you’re in a hurry
You are afraid for the future
You have enough time for yourself
You feel under pressure from deadlines

scoring.overall: Reverse positive items, sum all 20, then transform to 0–100 as ((sum-20)/60)*100. Higher values indicate greater perceived stress.

interpretation_note: Research measure of perceived stress. It is not the PSS-4 and scores are not interchangeable with PSS-4 scores.
